content.thinking: We created __pycache__ via py_compile; submission should not include? Ordinary files allowed but -B in scoring won't create; extra entries count, okay but best remove. Remove __pycache__.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && rm -rf __pycache__ && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os,stat
total=0;files=[];dirs=0
for root,ds,fs in os.walk('.'):
 dirs+=len(ds)
 for f in fs:
  p=os.path.join(root,f);st=os.lstat(p);total+=st.st_size;files.append(p)
print(len(files),dirs,total)
EOF
